desc: Phone co-op (a 6.1 in iPhone held sideways: the touch controls, no controller): a Bluetooth controller connecting mid-session and used is player 1's (port 1: the touch controls hide, co-op stays off); a second one is nobody until its Start, then player 2; player 2 walks and hops the partner, every hop back to standing; player 1 back on the screen (the controls come back, still player 1); a seat swap asked in player 2's menu, said yes to on the touch A, then back; controller 2 switched off: one player again
